name: Power quality analyser
summary: Instrument that measures and logs harmonics, flicker, dips, swells and unbalance at a point of the network.
description: A power quality analyser measures disturbances as well as ordinary quantities: harmonics, flicker, voltage dips and swells, unbalance and transients. It is installed at supply points and sensitive loads to show whether supply quality meets the agreed limits, and it keeps event logs for investigation.

Measurement methods for power quality are standardised so that different instruments give comparable results, and the class of measurement matters when results are used in disputes. The symbol does not show that class, the VT and CT bandwidth or the logging settings.
readingNotes: Check the measurement class claimed for the analyser.
Confirm CT and VT are suitable for harmonic frequencies.
distinction: A power quality analyser assesses disturbances; a multifunction meter mainly reports fundamental quantities and energy.
